items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He had Don Rd on piano, Omer Simeon on clarinet.

ctx.x: rehearsals, it would be around two or three o'clock in the afternoon. It would be about two hours. We'd sit around sometimes until four or 4:30. He had Don Rd on piano, Omer Simeon on clarinet.
